People perceive time differently. Those with time blindness have a hard time noticing time passing, which can make it easy to lose track of things or run late.

                 

You're creating a Time Blindness program to help users discover whether they struggle with tracking time. 

The program shows a random target time from 10 to 20 seconds. The user holds down D22, releasing it once they think the exact time has passed. The result is then displayed. 

Below is a flow diagram to guide you on the program flow. 

 

In this step, you will implement the FIRST PART: "Display Target and Hold D22 to Start". 

It displays the random target time with instruction but nothing will happen when the button is pressed for now.

You will need a variable to store the random target time.
